title: pfaffia paraguayensis var. typica
intro: Pfaffia paraguayensis var. typica, commonly known as suma, is a plant species that belongs to the Amaranthaceae family. It is traditionally used to treat a variety of health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and digestive issues, due to its potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pfaffia paraguayensis var. typica include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and modulating the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
